SHADOW LEAGUE FIGHTING  --  v2 ROMs  --  Eagle Software, 2026
==============================================================

!! WORK IN PROGRESS !!  NeoGeoSDK v1.7.5 Pre-Release Build v2.

Shadow League Fighting's expanded 44-fighter tournament build,
featuring multi-arena support, attract mode cinematics, and
arcade character selection. Every file carries "_v2" in its name.

- Full 44-fighter roster across 32 countries and martial disciplines.
- 4 distinct arena environments with parallax background layers.
- Attract mode with story prologue, how-to-play tutorial, and roster showcase.
- 8-stage tournament ladder ending with Project Chimera boss encounters.

FILES
-----
ShadowLeague-WIP-NeoSD_MVS_v2.neo     NeoSD image, arcade (MVS) build
ShadowLeague-WIP-NeoSD_AES_v2.neo     NeoSD image, console (AES) build
ShadowLeague-Darksoft-MVS_v2.zip      Darksoft Neo Geo Multi folder, MVS build
ShadowLeague-Darksoft-AES_v2.zip      Darksoft Neo Geo Multi folder, AES build
ShadowLeague-BackBit-MVS_v2.zip       BackBit Platinum folder, MVS build
ShadowLeague-BackBit-AES_v2.zip       BackBit Platinum folder, AES build
ShadowLeague-WIP-EagleBIOS_v2.zip     MAME: MVS build with EagleBIOS
ShadowLeague-WIP-AES-EagleBIOS_v2.zip MAME: AES build with EagleBIOS
ShadowLeague-CHANGELOG_v2.txt         Changelog for this release
ShadowLeague-MANIFEST_v2.txt          Checksums for every v2 file

CONTROLS
--------
Stick       Walk, crouch, jump; hold back to guard (down-back for low)
            Forward, Forward: Dash       Back, Back: Backdash
A  Light Punch      B  Light Kick      C  Heavy Punch      D  Heavy Kick
A + B       Tactical roll (invulnerable)
C + D       Heavy blowback / Guard cancel attack
Fwd/Back+C  Throw (close); tech with C or D
Down, Fwd + Attack: Special Moves
Super: 1 stock of power gauge
